extracted.intended_audience: prospective Jane Coffin Childs postdoctoral fellowship applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and eligibility/submission requirements for applying to the Jane Coffin Childs postdoctoral fellowship using the Temelio application portal, including required documents, referee/advisor roles, institutional signatory, and key dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Temelio platform for application submission
rubrics_metrics.description: The Jane Coffin Childs Fund uses the Temelio platform for application submission. All instructions to apply, with digital guides, can be found in the Temelio application portal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not follow former downloaded guidelines (explicitly: 'All former downloaded guidelines, including the 2026 guidelines should not be followed.'). Follow the instructions and digital guides available inside Temelio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant must register/complete application as an INDIVIDUAL
rubrics_metrics.description: Please complete the application as an 'INDIVIDUAL'. Do not select 'Organization' upon registering in Temelio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upon registering you will be presented with an 'Onboarding workflow'. Only your FULL NAME needs to be entered there; none of the other categories are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three referee letters required
rubrics_metrics.description: Three referee letters are required from qualified individuals who can evaluate the applicant’s qualifications for the proposed research project and assess the applicant’s potential for successful independent biomedical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referees must be individuals other than the applicant’s postdoctoral advisor (and co-advisor). For applicants with a Ph.D., the first referee letter should preferably come from the applicant’s thesis advisor. All referees must register in the Temelio site so that the information sent can be stored confidentially.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed postdoctoral advisor and co-advisor cannot serve as referees
rubrics_metrics.description: THE PROPOSED POSTDOCTORAL ADVISOR (and CO-ADVISOR IF APPLICABLE) CANNOT BE A REFEREE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the applicant will also have a co-proposed postdoctoral advisor, directions on what is required can be found in the proposed postdoctoral advisor form; however, the co-advisor cannot be one of the three referees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Postdoctoral Advisor Form is required
rubrics_metrics.description: The Proposed Postdoctoral Advisor Form is required to be completed by the person the applicant has selected as their primary postdoctoral advisor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All proposed primary postdoctoral advisors must register in the Temelio site so that all submitted information can be stored securely and confidentially. If there will be a co-advisor, the proposed postdoctoral advisor form contains directions on what is required for the co-advisor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referees/advisors/fiscal officer must register via emailed Temelio invite and use matching email
rubrics_metrics.description: From the application portal, the applicant will invite the appropriate contacts to receive an email with a link to upload the referee letters, access the proposed postdoctoral advisor form and to complete a Fiscal Officer signatory form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a referee, proposed postdoctoral advisor or Contract/Financial Officer receives their email invite, they must register by clicking 'Don’t have an account? “Sign Up”' (found under the big blue button) — they will not be able to enter the site otherwise. It is very important that the contacts use THE SAME email that the applicant used to send their email in the Temelio site when they register; they can then supply a password of their choice.

rubrics_metrics.name: One institutional signature required (grant/contract/financial officer)
rubrics_metrics.description: One signature is required that verifies that the grant and contract/financial officer at the proposed postdoctoral advisor’s institute is aware of the applicant’s submission to the Jane Coffin Childs Fund and is aware of the terms of the award as outlined on www.jccfund.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the applicant is awarded as a JCC Fellow, the award notification letter will be sent to the institutional contacts as noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: No administrative access; applicant controls access and can download submitted file
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no administrative access to the online application. All access to the application is through the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The applicant may download a copy of their submitted file for administrative purposes, but institutional administrators do not have direct access to the application portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key application and fellowship dates (deadlines and milestones)
rubrics_metrics.description: Important timeline for the 2027 cycle: Online application opens October 1, 2026; Applications and all supporting materials must be received no later than 3:00 pm EST, February 1, 2027; Award decisions made and applicants notified mid May 2027; Fellowship start date July 1, 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The February 1, 2027 deadline is absolute: 'No Exceptions.' Ensure all materials (including referee letters, advisor form, and fiscal officer signatory) are submitted and received in Temelio by 3:00 pm EST on that date.
